```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r library loading}
library(tidyverse)
library(cbioportalR)
library(data.table)


```

```{r pancan download}
set_cbioportal_db(db = "public")
tcga_avail <- available_studies() %>%
  filter(grepl('tcga_pan_can_atlas', studyId))

for(study in unique(tcga_avail$studyId)){
  data <- get_mutations_by_study(study_id = study)
  cancer_type <- str_split_i(study, '_', 1)
  write_tsv(data, paste0('mutations/pan_can_atlas/', cancer_type, '.tsv'))
}


```

```{r gdc download}
set_cbioportal_db(db = "public")
tcga_avail <- available_studies() %>%
  filter(grepl('tcga_gdc', studyId))

for(study in unique(tcga_avail$studyId)){
  data <- get_mutations_by_study(study_id = study)
  cancer_type <- str_split_i(study, '_', 1)
  write_tsv(data, paste0('mutations/gdc/', cancer_type, '.tsv'))
}


```

```{r pancan compilation}
full_mut_data <- fread(list.files('mutations/pan_can_atlas/', full.names = T)[1], data.table = F)
for (file in list.files('mutations/pan_can_atlas/', full.names = T)[2:length(list.files('mutations/pan_can_atlas/'))]){
  
  mut_data <- fread(file, data.table = F) 
  #remove columns we don't have in all files
  mut_data <- mut_data %>% 
    select(-c(colnames(mut_data)[!colnames(mut_data) %in% colnames(full_mut_data)]))
  
  full_mut_data <- rbind(full_mut_data, mut_data)
}

write_tsv(full_mut_data, 'mutations/pan_can_atlas/compiled.tsv')
```

```{r gdc compilation}
# Same compilation as above, run on the GDC study downloads (reproduces gdc/compiled.tsv byte-for-byte).
full_mut_data <- fread(list.files('mutations/gdc/', full.names = T)[1], data.table = F)
for (file in list.files('mutations/gdc/', full.names = T)[2:length(list.files('mutations/gdc/'))]){
  
  mut_data <- fread(file, data.table = F) 
  #remove columns we don't have in all files
  mut_data <- mut_data %>% 
    select(-c(colnames(mut_data)[!colnames(mut_data) %in% colnames(full_mut_data)]))
  
  full_mut_data <- rbind(full_mut_data, mut_data)
}

write_tsv(full_mut_data, 'mutations/gdc/compiled.tsv')
```
